title: Generate initial texture
action: Generate a set of 1000 crystal orientations for a polycrystal aggregate that reproduces the published basal texture: a {0002} pole figure with a peak intensity of approximately 8 MRD near the normal direction (ND) and a spread towards the rolling direction (RD). The same orientation set can be used for both Ti and HCP-MPEA as their textures are reported to be similar.
description: A process step that creates the synthetic texture input required by CPFEM. The orientations can be generated by sampling from a distribution fitted to the described pole figure peak and spread.

title: CPFEM shear vs strain
action: Using PRISMS-Plasticity, run uniaxial tension simulations on the 1000-grain aggregate separately for Ti (Table 1 parameters) and HCP-MPEA (Table 2 parameters) up to a true strain of approximately 0.15. At each output step, record the true strain and the normalized shear (total shear divided by the Burgers vector magnitude) for slip systems Prism ⟨a⟩, Pyr1 ⟨a⟩, and Pyr1 ⟨c+a⟩. Write the results to a CSV file.
description: Strain-dependent normalized shear values for the three key slip systems in Ti and HCP-MPEA. Each material has one row per strain step.
output_schema: Columns: material (string, 'Ti' or 'MPEA'), true_strain (float), slip_system (string, 'Prism_a', 'Pyr1_a', 'Pyr1_ca'), normalized_shear (float).

title: CPFEM shear at strain 0.08
action: From the same simulation results, interpolate or extract the normalized shear values for Prism ⟨a⟩, Pyr1 ⟨a⟩, and Pyr1 ⟨c+a⟩ at a true strain of approximately 0.08 for both Ti and HCP-MPEA. Write the six values to a CSV file.
description: Normalized shear values at the specific strain (~0.08) that is directly compared with the experimental slip-trace statistics in the paper. The values must be produced by the workflow that uses the generated texture and the published hardening parameters.
output_schema: Columns: material (string, 'Ti' or 'MPEA'), slip_system (string, 'Prism_a', 'Pyr1_a', 'Pyr1_ca'), normalized_shear (float). One row per material–slip_system combination (6 rows).
